content_zh:
经过选婚比武之后，萧叶家的门口，便经常有少女驻足徘徊，每当萧阳或者罗梅兰推门走出时，那些少女便如同受惊的小鹿，飞快的跑走。
“唉，这是这个月第几个了？”再一次看到这一幕，萧阳哭笑不得。
“那不是因为我儿子太厉害了。”罗梅兰喜上眉梢，紧接着无奈道，“可惜儿子一个都看不上啊。”
“愚蠢！”萧阳喝骂道，“你们妇道人家，就是目光短浅。我儿子以后是加入重阳门的，娶回来的都是天之骄女，又岂是这些女子可比的？”
虽然被萧阳喝骂，但罗梅兰却没有一点恼怒，反而笑眯眯的点头，脑海中不由得憧憬起来，自己未来的儿媳妇，是什么样的天之骄女。
时间之塔内，萧叶双手结成奇特的手印，体内的真气如同一条江河，在九条经脉中奔腾着。
相比较刚刚修炼混元功的时候，他的真气比那时候强壮太多了。
“大崩掌！”
蓦然间，萧叶双目睁开，激射出摄人心魄的精芒。与此同时，他起身双掌朝前拍出。
嘭嘭嘭！
三道响亮的轰鸣之声连成一片，从萧叶体内发出，磅礴的力量嘶吼着冲了出去，一路横扫形成一条迫人的气浪。
“大崩掌的威力，果然非同寻常！”望着眼前的一幕，萧叶满脸的兴奋。
大崩掌，利用经脉中的真气进行叠加攻击，修炼到圆满层次后，可以瞬间将真气叠加四次，攻击力强大。但叠加真气的前提，武者的真气必须足够充沛。
想到大崩掌的介绍，萧叶心中感慨，如同不是他修炼了混元功，就要错过如此强大的战技了。
“如今我的修为，已经突破到后天三重初期，如果配合圆满的大崩掌，后天三重中无人是我的对手！”萧叶身上涌现强大的自信。
混元功赋予了他浑厚的真气，而大崩掌则赋予了他强大的攻击力，两者相配合，萧叶绝对可以同阶称尊。
在时间之塔，他又苦修了三百多天，修为突飞猛进，大崩掌也差点修炼到圆满层次，实力不可同日而语。
而此时的外界，才仅仅过去一个多月的时间。
一个月，横跨数个小境界，如果外人得知，一定会惊骇无比，因为这个速度实在太快了！
“可惜，我现在只能将真气叠加三次，无法做到四次叠加。”萧叶有些不甘心，距离重阳门的入门选拔，可没有多少时间了，他要抓紧一切时间，努力提升实力。

否则，他谈何打败先天境的赵乾？
“看来一味的苦修，也不是办法，我还缺乏历练。”萧叶考虑了一会，决定去青阳镇附近的凶兽森林，找凶兽磨练大崩掌。
真灵大陆的凶兽，懂得一些修炼之道，实力同样强大。现在的他，已经拥有了一定的自保之力。
想到这里，萧叶的意识离开时间之塔，回归肉身。
“爹娘不在家？”萧叶对此也不在意，年关过后，萧家村的村民，本来就很忙碌。而萧阳也因为他的缘故，受到了村子的重视，经常为村子的一些事情忙碌奔波。
“叶儿！”萧叶走出家门，正准备向着凶兽森林而去的时候，只见萧天雄正从村内的小道走来。
“村长爷爷。”萧叶露出笑容。
“嗯。”萧天雄和蔼的点头，目露期待道，“听说你一直在闭关修炼，你现在达到什么境界了？”
萧叶狐疑的看了萧天雄一眼，这个老家伙，不是在故意等自己出来，询问自己的修炼进度吧？否则怎么会这么巧，自己才走出来，就碰上他了。
实际上，萧叶猜的八九不离十了，萧天雄经常往萧叶家中跑，探查萧叶的修炼进度，但那时候萧叶一直都在闭关。
“村长爷爷，我刚刚达到后天一重巅峰。”萧叶目光闪动了一下，露出灿烂的笑容。
如果不是需要的话，萧叶不想暴露自己真实的修为，免得引起轰动，引起一些不必要的麻烦。
“哦。”萧天雄略微有些失望，这个修炼速度，虽然也算相当不错了，但是却没有达到他内心的期望啊。
“那你好好修炼。”萧天雄叮嘱了几句，便转身离开了。
见萧天雄离开，萧叶无奈的摇了摇头，然后走出了村子。
在两人都走了以后，一个身穿兽皮的壮汉，从暗处走了出来，此人赫然便是萧霸。

content_en:
After the marriage selection competition, girls often stopped and lingered at the door of Xiao Ye's house. Whenever Xiao Yang or Luo Meilan opened the door and walked out, those girls would run away quickly like frightened deer.
"Hey, how many times is this this month?" Seeing this scene again, Henry Zhang couldn't laugh or cry.
"That's not because my son is so awesome." Luo Meilan was happy, and then said helplessly, "It's a pity that my son can't look down on anyone."
"Stupid!" Xiao Yang scolded, "You women are just short-sighted. My son will join the Chongyang Sect in the future, and the people he marries are all the proud daughters of heaven, how can these women be comparable?"
Although she was scolded by Henry Zhang, Luo Meilan was not angry at all. Instead, she nodded with a smile. She couldn't help but dream about what kind of proud daughter her future daughter-in-law would be.
In the Tower of Time, Xiao Ye's hands formed strange hand seals, and the true energy in his body was like a river, rushing through the nine meridians.
Compared to when he first started practicing Hunyuan Gong, his Qi was much stronger than that time.
"Big Collapse Palm!"
Suddenly, Xiao Ye's eyes opened, shooting out a breathtaking light. At the same time, he stood up and slapped his palms forward.
Bang bang bang!
Three loud roaring sounds connected together, emanating from Xiao Ye's body, and the majestic power roared out, sweeping all the way to form a forceful wave of air.
"The power of the Big Collapse Palm is indeed extraordinary!" Looking at the scene in front of him, Xiao Ye's face was full of excitement.
Big Beng Palm uses the true energy in the meridians to carry out superimposed attacks. After practicing to the perfect level, you can instantly superimpose the true energy four times, and the attack power is powerful. But the prerequisite for superimposing true energy is that the warrior's true energy must be sufficient.
Thinking of the introduction of Big Beng Palm, Xiao Ye sighed in his heart, as if he had not practiced Hunyuan Gong, he would have missed such a powerful combat skill.
"Now that my cultivation level has reached the early stage of the third level of acquired cultivation, if I cooperate with the perfect Big Collapse Palm, no one in the third level of acquired cultivation can be my opponent!" Xiao Ye felt strong self-confidence.
The Hunyuan Gong gave him a strong vitality, while the Big Beng Palm gave him a powerful attack power. With the two combined, Xiao Ye could definitely be respected at the same level.
In the Tower of Time, he practiced hard for more than three hundred days, and his cultivation improved by leaps and bounds. He almost reached the perfect level of Big Beng Palm cultivation, and his strength was incomparable.
At this time, only more than a month had passed in the outside world.
In one month, it spans several small realms. If outsiders knew about it, they would be horrified because this speed is so fast!
"It's a pity that I can only stack the zhenqi three times now, and I can't stack it four times." Xiao Ye was a little unwilling. There was not much time left before the entrance selection of the Chongyang Sect. He had to seize all the time and work hard to improve his strength.
Otherwise, how could he defeat Zhao Qian in the Xiantian realm?
"It seems that blindly practicing hard is not the answer. I still lack experience." Xiao Ye thought for a while and decided to go to the ferocious beast forest near Qingyang Town to find ferocious beasts to hone the Big Collapse Palm.
The ferocious beasts in the True Spirit Continent know some ways of cultivation and are equally powerful. Now he has a certain ability to protect himself.
Thinking of this, Xiao Ye's consciousness left the Tower of Time and returned to his physical body.
"My parents are not at home?" Xiao Ye didn't care about this. After the New Year, the villagers of Xiaojia Village were already very busy. And because of him, Xiao Yang received the attention of the village and was often busy with some matters in the village.
"Ye'er!" Xiao Ye walked out of the house and was about to head towards the beast forest when he saw Xiao Tianxiong walking from the path in the village.
"Grandpa Village Chief." Xiao Ye smiled.
"Yes." Xiao Tianxiong nodded kindly and said expectantly, "I heard that you have been practicing in seclusion. What state have you reached now?"
Xiao Ye glanced at Xiao Tianxiong suspiciously. This old guy wasn't waiting for him to come out on purpose.Are you asking about your cultivation progress? Otherwise, how could it be such a coincidence that I just walked out and bumped into him.
In fact, Xiao Ye's guess was close. Xiao Tianxiong often ran to Xiao Ye's home to check on Xiao Ye's cultivation progress, but Xiao Ye had been in retreat at that time.
"Grandpa Village Chief, I have just reached the peak of the acquired first level." Xiao Ye's eyes flashed and he showed a bright smile.
If it is not necessary, Xiao Ye does not want to expose his true cultivation level, so as not to cause a sensation and cause unnecessary trouble.
"Oh." Xiao Tianxiong was slightly disappointed. Although this cultivation speed was quite good, it did not meet his inner expectations.
"Then you practice hard." Xiao Tianxiong warned him a few words, then turned and left.
Seeing Xiao Tianxiong leaving, Xiao Ye shook his head helplessly and walked out of the village.
After both of them left, a strong man wearing animal skins came out of the darkness. This man was clearly Xiao Ba.
